blocks.text: 🪝 Govt Introduces MMDR Amendment Bill 2026 in Lok Sabha; Removes 50% Captive Sales Ceiling. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Mines and Minerals Amendment Bill 2026 introduced in Lok Sabha, removing 50% sales cap on captive mines and expanding NMET.
**Captive Mine Ceiling Removed:** Bill removes 50% ceiling on annual mineral sales by captive mines after meeting end-use requirements.
**Trust Expansion:** Renames NMET to **National Mineral Exploration and Development Trust** to fund mine development.
**Lease Extension:** Composite licence extended up to 30%; mining lease up to 10%; one-time extension for deep-seated minerals (>200m depth).
⚠️ **Depth Threshold:** Deep-seated minerals defined as minerals found >200 meters below land surface.
